audit.proof_assessment: No proof artifacts were supplied; assessment is from the diff only. Hash pins (frozen first-three slice, P1 self-hash, amendment/receipt digests, without-packetDigest) are internally consistent with each other and with live-hash checks in scripts/verify-r1-phase-authorization.mjs, but they were not independently recomputed here. New node tests encode fail-closed oracles for (1)-(5) and were not executed in this review.
residual_risks: Frozen first-three byte pin cannot be compared to git show BASE_COMMIT at verify time (copied fixture, no git); a wrong pin that matches the current slice would still pass.
No source-scope walk of the tree or diff; later P1 work that edits files outside allowedPaths is not caught by this module.
Effect/forbidden-effect lists are not enforced against actual code.
Grok receipts are required by the module and tests but are not in the supplied git diff; a clean checkout fails closed if they are absent.
unavailableControls row bodies and owner-acceptance extra keys are weakly checked; contradiction there is still blocked by pinned independentHumanReview/grants and by receipt target hashes.
T02 receipt re-pin (four targetHashes) is a follow-up; P1 receipts omit that file and bind authority-manifest.json only via canonical-json-v1 without /packetDigest.
